info.title: LedgerGuard P08F administrator investigation
info.description: Synthetic money only. ADMIN-only transaction, journal, audit and consistent-snapshot reconciliation interface. No real banking integration, production readiness, or whole-product completion claim. Existing customer contracts remain unchanged.

get.description: One read-only repeatable-read snapshot connects the operation, complete journal (max 100 entries; larger journals return controlled conflict rather than truncation), first 25 adjustments, first 25 related outbox events and first 25 failed work items. More flags are explicit. Canonical audit bytes and raw broker envelopes are omitted; no mutation, balance editor or inferred audit-integrity pass. Refund/reversal reason remains in the existing protected adjustment receipt.

post.description: ADMIN + CSRF. Client generates and preserves one report UUID; body UUID, not an unrelated Idempotency-Key header, identifies the report. A same-actor retry returns the original report. Other-actor UUID collision is 409. Financial scan is database-enforced READ ONLY REPEATABLE READ with 8-second statement / 12-second transaction budgets. Completed immutable report is then inserted separately, ON CONFLICT id DO NOTHING. Snapshot categories are explicit, complete discrepancy counts have at most ten samples per check. Backlog alone is not corruption. No repair operation exists. On lost response retain this UUID and explicitly retry or GET it. Unknown JSON fields are rejected.

post.description: Existing audited ADMIN+CSRF command reuses original event identity. Accepted is not settled or republished. The legacy API permits FAILED or REPUBLISHED; P08F UI deliberately offers replay only for FAILED. It does not promise idempotent replay cycles. No automatic retry on uncertainty: inspect current state before another explicit action.
